Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action

Class ActionConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.ActionConfig
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActionChainOptions, BaseFindOptions, ClickAndTypeOptions, ClickOptions, DefineRegionOptions, DragOptions, FindAndClick, FindAndType, HighlightOptions, KeyDownOptions, KeyUpOptions, MouseDownOptions, MouseMoveOptions, MouseUpOptions, NestedFindsOptions, PlaybackOptions, ScrollOptions, TypeOptions
public abstract class ActionConfig extends Object
Abstract base class for all action configurations in the Brobot framework.

This class defines the common parameters that are applicable to any action, such as timing, success criteria, and illustration settings. It uses a generic, inheritable Builder pattern to ensure that all specialized configuration classes can provide a consistent and fluent API.

Specialized configuration classes (e.g., ClickOptions, FindOptions) must extend this class.
